mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.activity_img, u.settings_id, u.signature FROM user u INNER JOIN app_settings s ON u.settings_id = s.id WHERE u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{matchWord}, '%') AND s.find_by_nickname = 2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_block b WHERE (b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.block_id = u.id) OR (b.user_id = u.id AND b.block_id = #{userId}) )
